summary: Frontend-only test of /watchlist (Nivel 2) mobile header layout parity with /portfolio (Nivel 1), and new 'Añadir' add-ticker flow. All primary user requirements verified: no horizontal overflow at 390x844, Add button visible on mobile & desktop, dialog opens with autocomplete, selecting AAPL adds a row and shows success toast, dialog closes, Cancel closes dialog without adding. Portfolio (Nivel 1) also renders without horizontal overflow on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Watchlist.jsx is 435 lines with modal, table, cards, and effects colocated. Consider extracting AddTickerDialog and DeleteConfirmDialog into separate components for maintainability.
Multiple console 401 errors observed on /api/user/me while unauthenticated — expected but noisy; consider guarding the initial call when no session cookie is present.
test_credentials: session_token cookie 'test_profile_token_fixed_123' available; flow also tested anonymously via localStorage — works.
